headline: Ms. Rachel Matches Macklemore's $1M Pledge to Children's Fund
meta_description: Ms. Rachel has matched Macklemore's $1 million commitment to a children's relief fund, calling on other wealthy celebrities to join the effort.
summary_short: Ms. Rachel has matched Macklemore's $1 million pledge to a children's relief fund and is urging other wealthy white celebrities to contribute.
body:
Ms. Rachel has matched Macklemore's $1 million pledge to a children's relief fund, amplifying the musician's recent commitment with an equal donation of her own.

The gesture represents a growing momentum among public figures to support children in need. Ms. Rachel's decision to match the contribution and extend an invitation to other wealthy white celebrities demonstrates how individual acts of giving can spark broader community participation in philanthropy.
quick_facts: Ms. Rachel matched Macklemore's $1 million donation
The funds support a children's relief organization
Ms. Rachel called on other wealthy white celebrities to contribute
